findings.problem: Result from parse::<u32>() is discarded via unwrap(). This is a forbidden construct: unwrap can panic on non-numeric input, making the function panic-bound on untrusted input.
findings.failure_mode: Panic on malformed input - parse_scores will abort the process if any line contains non-u32 text
findings.fix: Replace unwrap with ? or a typed error return. Change return type to Result<Vec<u32>, ParseError> or use a dedicated error enum, then map each parse result with ? inside the iterator chain.
